title: 第522章 赵倩倩脸红第521章 豆包飞
content_zh:
第522章赵倩倩脸红
赵小抠这时六神无主起来，一屁股坐在地上，开始嚎着啕大哭：“哎呀我该怎么办呢？我以后该怎么生活啊？”
看着这家伙平时讹人不讲理的小老头，这个时候变成了一个哭丧的泼妇，众人一阵哑然失笑。
在众人一筹莫展之时，陈楚出声道：“我说张大福啊，为今之计你应该先去买个锅。”
“买锅？”赵小抠眨了眨眼。
“对呀，你的锅不都崩飞了吗？先买个锅，把豆包摘下来，洗洗还能吃，接着做饭。另外呢，屋子虽然被炸的不成样子，收拾收拾还能住。”
“不过你也要长教训，为啥最近你的坏事接二二连三呢？先是腿瘸了，然后房子又烧没了，现在老房子又被炸了，就说明你的心术不正，你马上把心事摆正，以后不要干那种讹人的勾搭。我保证你以后顺风顺水风顺水。”
“真的吗？”赵小抠不相信的看着陈楚。
陈楚点了点头：“你女儿我可以聘请她到我的厂子做会计或者库管。这样有一份工资，你的两个儿子，等我的果汁厂建好了之后，也可以让他们到我那里做，去做保安。这一家几口人不都有了工作了吗？你这个小老头没事在家种种地，收拾收拾房间，日子不也起来了吗？”
“真的吗？”赵小抠我又不敢相信的揉了揉眼睛。
一旁的村长张有才呵呵笑道：“老哥啊，你要相信陈先生，陈先生给咱们村快把路修好了，以后村里的山货能够卖的出去，而且呢厂房也快建好了。以后生产饮料正是需要人手的时候。但是你如果以后再出去讹人名声不好，人家陈先生是不会用你家的人做工的。”
赵小抠一骨碌从地上爬起来，呼出了一口浊气，转忧为喜：“陈先生你放心，经历了这些事，我发誓我以后再不讹人了。”
随后便摸出电话给女儿打去：“倩倩啊，你快从你老姨家回来吧，陈先生这边要建个工厂，你要你去那里上班呢。”
陈楚不搭理他，到了自己的果汁厂，这里的厂房已经建好，仓库和生产车间也已经收拾妥当，只要把果子收上来便可以榨汁装瓶进行销售了。至于销售渠道，这点不用担心，自己的火锅店就是最好的线下销售渠道。
下午的时候，赵倩倩从她老姨家回来，便给陈楚打了电话。两人把见面的地点约在了村东头的苞米地。
赵倩倩到了苞米地附近四处张望，陈楚从里面出来：“倩倩，你来啦。”
“哎，你为啥要把见面的地点约在这呢？”
陈楚笑了笑，随后指着身后的一片高耸连绵的苞米地说：“这里可是青纱帐啊，在这里面谈事情又凉快又隐蔽又有情调。”
“切，我倒没觉得苞米地有啥情调。”
陈楚伸出手拉住赵倩倩，把她拉进了苞米地。然后扯了几片苞米叶子垫在地上，让赵倩倩屁股坐在上面，随后自己也坐在垄台上。

“倩倩，你算账还可以吧？”
“那个没问题，我念过高中的。”
“那好，以后果汁厂你就是那的会计，干好了给你升职副厂长。”
赵倩倩这时脸上忽然红润了一下：“那我爹的腿……”
陈楚拍了拍脑门：“差点忘了，今天又可以给你爹治腿了，可以进入第二个疗程。一共七个疗程。不过倩倩，你今天穿的这是啥裤子啊？这还带个兜。”
其实赵倩倩今天穿的只是很寻常不过的牛仔裤了，屁股上带兜也是很正常的。陈楚抓住那个兜。赵倩倩犹豫了一下，没有拒绝。
陈楚一手揽着她的细腰，另一只手捏住她白嫩的下巴，一口亲住了她红彤彤的小嘴巴。甘甜的亲吻让陈楚浑身如同过了电一样的麻酥酥的，而赵倩倩也感觉到了幸福和甜蜜。
content_en:
Chapter 522 Zhao Qianqian blushes
At this time, Zhao Xiaozhao got up and sat down on the ground, crying loudly: "Oh, what should I do? How should I live in the future?"
Seeing that this little old man, who usually blackmailed people and was unreasonable, turned into a mournful shrew, everyone burst into laughter.
When everyone was at a loss what to do, Chen Chu said: "I say Zhang Dafu, for this plan you should buy a pot first."
"Buy a pot?" Zhao Xiaojie blinked.
"That's right, didn't your pot fall apart? Buy a pot first, pick off the bean buns, wash them and still eat them, and then cook. Besides, although the house was damaged by the bombing, you can still live in it after cleaning it up."
"But you also need to learn a lesson. Why have you been doing bad things one after another recently? First your leg was lame, then the house was burned down, and now the old house was bombed again. This shows that your intentions are not right. You should put your mind right immediately and don't do that kind of blackmail in the future. I guarantee that you will have smooth sailing in the future."
"Really?" Zhao Xiaozhao looked at Chen Chu in disbelief.
Chen Chu nodded: "I can hire your daughter to work as an accountant or warehouse manager in my factory. This way, with a salary, your two sons, after my juice factory is built, can also let them work for me as security guards. Don't all the members of this family have jobs? You, a little old man, have nothing to do at home, farming, tidying up the room, and your life is getting better?"
"Really?" Zhao Xiaoxiao rubbed his eyes again in disbelief.
The village chief Zhang Youcai laughed and said: "Brother, you have to believe Mr. Chen. Mr. Chen will soon build the road in our village. In the future, the mountain products in the village will be sold, and the factory will be built soon. In the future, manpower will be needed to produce beverages. But if you go out to blackmail people with a bad reputation in the future, Mr. Chen will not use your people to work."
Zhao Xiaozhao got up from the ground, exhaled a breath of turbid breath, and turned from worry to joy: "Mr. Chen, don't worry, after what I have experienced, I swear that I will never blackmail anyone again."
Then he took out his phone and called his daughter: "Qianqian, please come back from your aunt's house quickly. Mr. Chen is going to build a factory here, and I want you to go work there."
Chen Chu ignored him and arrived at his juice factory. The factory building here has been built, and the warehouse and production workshop have been packed up. As long as the fruits are collected, the juice can be squeezed, bottled and sold. As for sales channels, don’t worry about this. Your own hot pot restaurant is the best offline sales channel.
In the afternoon, Zhao Qianqian came back from her aunt's house and called Chen Chu. The two arranged to meet at Baomi Di at the east end of the village.
Zhao Qianqian arrived near the corn field and looked around. Chen Chu came out: "Qianqian, you are here."
"Hey, why did you decide to meet here?"
Chen Chu smiled, then pointed to a tall stretch of corn behind him and said, "This is the green gauze tent. It's cool, secluded and romantic to hold interviews here."
"Tch, I don't think Baomi Di is very sentimental."
Chen Chu stretched out his hand to hold Zhao Qianqian and pulled her into the corn field. Then he pulled out a few corn leaves and put them on the ground, letting Zhao Qianqian sit on them, and then she also sat on the platform.
"Qianqian, can you settle the score?"
"That's no problem. I went to high school."
"Okay, from now on you will be the accountant of the juice factory. Once you are done, you will be promoted to deputy director."
Zhao Qianqian's face suddenly turned red at this moment: "Then my dad's legs..."
Chen Chu patted his forehead: "I almost forgot, today I can treat your father's legs again, and you can enter the second course of treatment. There are seven courses of treatment in total. But Qianqian, what kind of pants are you wearing today? You also need to bring a pocket."
In fact, what Zhao Qianqian is wearing today is just ordinary cowboy clothes.If you wear jeans, it is normal to have pockets on your buttocks. Chen Chu grabbed the pocket. Zhao Qianqian hesitated for a moment but did not refuse.
Chen Chu held her slender waist with one hand, pinched her white chin with the other hand, and kissed her red mouth. The sweet kiss made Chen Chu's whole body tingle like electricity, and Zhao Qianqian also felt happiness and sweetness.
